note: Primitive Parks Canada campground in mixed aspen near the Belly River on the Chief Mountain Highway, 26 km from Waterton townsite and 5 km from the Chief Mountain border crossing. Parks Canada posts a 21-ft RV limit and back-in sites only. No drinking water; kitchen shelter, grey-water disposal and a food locker at every site. Cell service is very limited. --Claude
